metadata.reconciliation: Autonomous self-healing suite for Woodpecker HealthCI covering DCB0129 provenance, tiered quarantine, predictive sizing, YAML config repair, multi-agent cross-check, bounded counterfactuals, and air-gapped Qwen 2.5 Coder.

test_cases.scenario: AI patch with dual human sign-off (Senior Dev + Certified CSO) merges to main
expected_outcomes: Patch record successfully stored with symphonix-healer[bot] author and DID healer-v1
Diff checksum SHA-256 computed deterministically
Merge verification succeeds when two human reviews including CSO are recorded
test_cases.preconditions: AI patch generated by Qwen 2.5 Coder for step failure; dual reviews signed
test_cases.notes: Full DCB0129 audit trail with cryptographic Merkle diff hash (FR-HEAL-001-AC01)

test_cases.scenario: Direct merge attempt of AI patch to protected branch without human review fails closed
expected_outcomes: Merge verification returns ErrDCB0129ProvenanceViolation
Patch remains unmerged in protected repository branch
test_cases.preconditions: AI patch recorded with zero human sign-offs; target branch is main
test_cases.notes: Prohibits autonomous AI bot cutover into clinical production without human review

test_cases.scenario: Merge attempt with two non-CSO reviewers rejected for lack of certified Clinical Safety Officer
expected_outcomes: Merge verification returns ErrDCB0129ProvenanceViolation for missing CSO sign-off
Repository blocks protected cutover
test_cases.preconditions: Patch has 2 engineering sign-offs but 0 certified Clinical Safety Officers
validation_rules: error.contains('missing mandatory Clinical Safety Officer') == true
test_cases.notes: Statutory healthcare requirement: non-CSO engineers cannot authorize clinical safety cutover

test_cases.scenario: Merge of draft AI patch into non-protected feature branch permitted without full CSO sign-off
expected_outcomes: Merge verification succeeds for non-protected feature branch
Developer sandboxing preserved without premature governance block
test_cases.preconditions: AI patch targeted at feature/sandbox-eval branch
test_cases.notes: Allows agile prototyping in isolated feature sandboxes while guarding main

test_cases.scenario: Attempting to quarantine a clinical safety evaluation test is strictly rejected
expected_outcomes: QuarantineTest returns ErrClinicalTestCannotBeQuarantined
Test remains active and unquarantined in pipeline test suite
test_cases.preconditions: Test identifier contains sepsis triage golden eval benchmark
test_cases.notes: Hard clinical invariant: Clinical safety evals and golden datasets can NEVER be silenced

test_cases.scenario: Non-clinical UI/integration flaky test quarantined with 72-hour TTL and ticket linkage
expected_outcomes: Quarantine record created with 72-hour TTL expiration
Test reported as actively quarantined during TTL window
Issue ticket ID recorded for author follow-up

test_cases.notes: Isolates non-clinical UI timing variance from blocking critical pipeline runs

test_cases.scenario: Quarantine record exceeding 72-hour TTL automatically expires and forces test re-run
expected_outcomes: IsQuarantined returns false and ErrQuarantineExpired
Expired record purged from active quarantine set
test_cases.preconditions: Quarantine timestamp set 80 hours in the past
test_cases.notes: Prevents permanent test debt by expiring quarantines after 72 hours

test_cases.scenario: Historical P95 memory telemetry pre-emptively rightsizes container limits with 20% headroom
expected_outcomes: PredictStepMemory returns rightsized memory allocation exceeding default 1024MB
Allocation includes 20% safety headroom over historical P95 peak
Step execution starts with rightsized memory, completely preventing Exit 137 OOM
test_cases.preconditions: Step has 10 historical records with peaks between 1200MB and 2000MB
test_cases.notes: Eliminates initial container crash by provisioning P95 * 1.20 headroom upfront

test_cases.scenario: Step with zero execution telemetry safely defaults to standard container memory
expected_outcomes: PredictStepMemory returns default limit (1024MB)
was_rightsized flag returns false without error
test_cases.preconditions: First-time step execution with empty telemetry store
test_cases.notes: Handles cold-start steps gracefully without telemetry dependencies

test_cases.scenario: Self-healing config repairer identifies mock bypass and missing Tink AEAD key, generating unified diff
expected_outcomes: IssuesDetected includes L-CAID-10 (Critical) and SEC-TINK-01 (Error)

test_cases.notes: Enforces Zero-Mock compliance and at-rest envelope encryption via interactive 1-click diff

test_cases.scenario: Pipeline configuration containing privileged container flag is flagged as critical and remediated
